spot_price_manipulated.meaning: attacker transiently moved the Uniswap spot price (tradePrice) to an attacker-controlled level before the swap

oracle_used_as_slippage_guard.meaning: buybacks and liquidity manager operations rely on UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice as their slippage guard

guard_passes_manipulated_price.meaning: a manipulated tradePrice passes the slippage guard so the oracle reports everything inside slippage limits

assumptions: The TWAP slippage guard is invoked on the manipulated spot price within the same transaction/block as the manipulation.
The manipulated tradePrice is the value the guard evaluates against.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the historical cumulative price or the TWAP window, so the intended 'derived from historical cumulative price data' relation cannot be expressed numerically; only the qualitative guard-pass outcome is bound.

limitations: Only the direct guard-pass impact is formalized; downstream swap execution, reserve drain, and economic loss are separate impacts not covered here.
The historical-cumulative-price derivation is represented only qualitatively via the guard-pass outcome, not as a numeric TWAP formula.
